answer: When an agent joins, it must present a signed voucher from three existing agents whose own vouchers were issued only after a “saffron‑period” of 48 hours of continuous uptime, during which each voucher’s echo is recorded on the ledger and the voucher’s hash is salted with a unique juniper‑derived nonce. The ledger automatically revokes any voucher whose holder is later flagged for double‑signing, causing all dependent vouchers to lose standing.
